label: Filter
depicts: Cup shaped funnel filter with an oval rim and short lower stem
use_when: Use when the interface wants a cup shaped funnel with an oval rim rather than straight funnel sides.
avoid_when: Do not use for the pointed funnel or stacked bars when the top should read as a cup rim.

label: Fingerprint
depicts: Fingerprint swirl with three open curved ridge line traces inside one centered spiral
use_when: Use when the interface wants a simpler fingerprint swirl with three main ridge lines.
avoid_when: Do not use for the denser fingerprint when a fourth outer ridge line should remain visible.

label: Fingerprint
depicts: Fingerprint swirl with four open curved ridge line traces inside one centered spiral
use_when: Use when the interface wants a fuller fingerprint swirl with four visible ridge lines.
avoid_when: Do not use for the simpler fingerprint when only three ridge bands should appear.

label: Flask
depicts: Chemistry flask with a narrow neck above a wide triangular base
use_when: Use when the interface wants a conical chemistry flask with a narrow neck and broad base.
avoid_when: Do not use for the beaker page or round bottom flask when the body should taper to angled sides.

label: Flask
depicts: Tall laboratory beaker with a folded lip and three inner measure line marks inside
use_when: Use when the interface wants a tall beaker with side measurement lines and a folded lip.
avoid_when: Do not use for the triangular flask or round bottom flask when the body should stay rectangular.
